body:
I had written a not so bad first toruament report but Deck Tech ate it with their stupid "can’t be logged in for more than 10 minutes becaue I don’t know how to program cookies" login system



I went 2 and 4 in my first tournament ever, pulled a Depa Billba from my prizes



Thanks to my friend Eugene for driving



The other one was much longer and I don’t feel like typing it again.
title: Grrr
author: Mike Lynch
event_desc: a tournament in the basement of a game store in Berkeley, California, run by Mike Mendoza
summary: Mike Lynch's note that DeckTech lost his first tournament report; he went 2–4 at the November 2001 Berkeley tournament and pulled a Depa Billaba from his prizes. The rewritten report is [[Mike Lynch Would the Real TR Please Stand Up (tournament report)]].
notes: Previously skipped as a lost-report note (duplicate_of d3136, removed: this is a separate post). Published per Bill 2026-10-25 as a note attached to his report d3136 (posted the next day), which gives the event: Berkeley, California, 18 November 2001, his first tournament, 2–4.
Event fields copied from d3136 ([[November 2001 Berkeley tournament]], built and live). No games given in this note; record 2–4 as stated ('I went 2 and 4').
'Depa Billba' in the text = Depa Billaba; friend Eugene (driver) has no surname.
